rules: Translate into natural Traditional Chinese as a Taiwanese QA tester would write it (spec-casebook/references/zh-copy.md): rewrite each sentence the way it is said in Chinese, never word by word; keep every 「…」 UI string, ID (TC-, R-, KP-, Q-), eBug code, file name, number and unit exactly; keep numbered steps one per line with the same numbers; in Precondition, Action and Expected Result keep the English lines one for one (same count, same numbers, the same 「步驟 N：」 prefix), never joined with ；.

en.Precondition:
1. In the AI Hair Color room with a portrait photo with one clear, front-facing face (passes every entry check)
2. The Custom panel is open
3. Account with at least 30 credits
en.Action:
1. Tap the balayage style (Balayage)
2. Choose a dark Base Color and a vivid Highlight Color
3. Tap Generate
en.Expected Result:
The result shows the balayage pattern: the Highlight Color is swept through the lengths over the Base Color
The hairstyle outline, hair length, face, background and clothes do not change
6 credits are taken
